bootstrap: 500 resamples of 7-day blocks, percentile 95% CI, seed 20261101
calm_start: both classes restricted to minutes less than x/4 below the trailing-240-min high
decomposition: AUC_standard = (1-pi)*AUC(pre-onset positives vs negatives) + pi*AUC(in-decline positives vs negatives); Kamran-style restricted AUC = AUC(pre-onset positives vs all negatives); in-decline share of above-chance AUC = pi*(AUC_in-0.5)/(AUC_standard-0.5)
evaluation_minutes: 2023-01-01 to 2026-05-01 minus 245 min, notebook-16 VALID mask
event_study: score percentile vs the 2022 distribution, minutes (-480, 240) around the 1% onset, dev events, L1 models
holdouts: not used (BTC 2018-2020 and alt 2018-2019 are locked)

in_decline_split.event: L1 only: t >= 1% onset of the event that makes the label positive (notebooks 12/16 endpoint definition)
in_decline_split.state: close_t at least x/4 below the trailing-240-min high (observable at t)

labels.L1_event: catalog breach (x% below trailing-240-min peak, 5-min sustain, 24h refractory) 30-240 min after minute t; the notebook 4-17 training label
labels.L2_forward: min close over (t, t+240] <= (1-x) * close_t; the common forward-drawdown label

models.L1: notebook-16 frozen models (M0 coefficient guard, M3 SHA-256 guard); M1 z_vol and M2 VPIN raw scores
models.L2: notebook-16 features and settings, trained on 2021 minus the last 245 minutes with the L2 label

title: Standard per-sample evaluation vs pre-onset-only evaluation (dev 2023-01..2026-04, exploratory)
within_regime: AUC over positive-negative pairs in the same 24h realized-volatility decile (deciles over evaluation minutes)
